item.title: Your weight in About you, and in Progress pictures
item.summary: About you now has Weight next to Height, and Progress share pictures use your saved height and weight so your body looks like you.
item.details: Pick your weight in pounds, or kilograms on a phone set to metric, and Murph saves it with your other health data. A weight already in Apple Health shows there too. Pictures use it without putting it on the card or in Messages, and still work when no weight is saved.
